title: Worth every penny!
text: The staff were absolutely amazing! We were only 6 people on the boat. Great atmosphere. Lovely views. There is more than one boat and they all sail out at the same time. It was absolutely worth the money. It's great for all occasions, with family, friends or couples. The staff leave you to enjoy your time but are available for anything and will also offer you snacks and drinks. If you get sea sick, do not sit towards the front of the boat! It can get a bit bumpy so take good care when walking back and forth or moving about. Will definitely do this again next time I am in Barcelona!!!
author: Assina_R

title: A very enjoyable way to spend an evening in Barcelona. Highly recommended!
text:
A very enjoyable way to spend an evening in Barcelona. Highly recommended!

With only eight people on board, the atmosphere was peaceful and relaxed. Everyone chatted within their own group while enjoying the scenery, making for a calm and intimate sailing experience.

Even though it was a cloudy evening, the views of Barcelona from the sea were beautiful, and we still managed to catch the sunset! The sea was a bit rough at times, but it didn't take away from the experience at all. Thanks to the captain!
